items.name: App creation
items.friction: AI-built prototypes emerge outside a common operating model.
items.functionality: Any creation tool can deploy into one governed organization.
items.outcome: Faster experimentation without a new shadow platform.

items.name: Source & CI/CD
items.friction: Non-developers need help turning local work into a durable service.
items.functionality: Git remains the source of truth with per-commit previews and atomic rollback.
items.outcome: One delivery path for builders and engineering.

items.name: Agent execution
items.friction: Generated code and long-running work require bespoke runtime operations.
items.functionality: Isolated sandboxes, Fluid Compute, and durable workflows run on one platform.
items.outcome: Less infrastructure to assemble and operate.

items.name: Identity & access
items.friction: Authentication and offboarding are wired independently for every app.
items.functionality: SSO, SCIM, managed users, and deployment protection inherit IdP policy.
items.outcome: Access is consistent from first preview to production.

items.name: Spend controls
items.friction: Distributed keys and vendors make runaway usage difficult to stop.
items.functionality: Project and key-level budgets, usage visibility, and hard caps.
items.outcome: Attributable spend with an enforceable ceiling.

items.name: Security posture
items.friction: WAF, secrets, audit evidence, and controls are reconstructed per app.
items.functionality: Managed secrets, edge protection, audit logs, and inherited platform controls.
items.outcome: A smaller control surface with clearer evidence.

items.name: Internal developer platform
items.friction: Portal and tooling contracts create another platform for engineering to maintain.
items.functionality: Builders own native apps while RBAC, policy, and publishing stay centralized.
items.outcome: More self-service with less platform overhead.

items.name: Private connectivity
items.friction: Each workload needs bespoke networking and credential exchange.
items.functionality: Secure Compute, static egress, OIDC, and Vercel Connect reach private systems.

items.name: Observability & recovery
items.friction: Telemetry fragments by app and recovery depends on team-specific runbooks.
items.functionality: Unified traces, spend, ownership, immutable artifacts, and instant rollback.
items.outcome: Faster diagnosis and a reliable recovery path.

items.name: Data & model access
items.friction: Teams hand-roll connectors and operate separate model gateways.
items.functionality: Marketplace integrations and AI Gateway centralize data and model access.
items.outcome: One governed route to enterprise data and AI.
